audit.why: Lane difficulty 7.5/10 with a 52.7% K'Sante win rate over 1370 games is consistent: Mordekaiser owns levels 2-3 and the level-6 realm, K'Sante owns the item stages. The current level chart (Morde 2 / Skill 1 / K'Sante 4) matches the win rate and the full and content layers already agree row for row, so no chart flip is proposed. The packet's stale chart (Morde 4/7) is the source of the recorded defect, not the shipped chart.

Spikes are right in order: Mordekaiser's level 2-3 Obliterate + Indestructible window, his level 6 Realm of Death (140/120/100s), his first AP item, then K'Sante's Iceborn Gauntlet and 2+ item front-line window. Language tightened with real cooldowns rather than re-ordered.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer claims K'Sante's W 'charge to become unstoppable'. Riot's own text for Path Maker says only that he 'charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes'. Unstoppable is not in the kit file and is not verifiable from it, so the page asserted a mechanic that decides whether you survive Realm of Death.
audit.why: Point 4 must state what the kits actually support. Damage reduction on the W charge is stated in the description; unstoppable status is not, and telling a player to W to become unstoppable inside the realm is advice they will die on if it is wrong.
audit.corrected: Replaced the unstoppable claim with the supported behaviour: W's charge-up reduces damage taken, so it is timed for his Obliterate slam inside the realm rather than used as a status-immunity button. Also added the real cooldowns Morde punishes on: Obliterate 8/7/6/5/4s, Death's Grasp pull 16/14/12/10/8s at 700 range, Indestructible 12/11/10/9/8s, Realm of Death 140/120/100s at 650 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] was titled 'Build MR' but its description was a copy of the generic trading line and never said what to build or why.
audit.why: Mordekaiser's damage is entirely magic and Indestructible converts stored damage into a heal, which is the flagged missing interaction for this matchup (needs-antiheal).
audit.corrected: Named the actual items: magic-resist stacking against an all-magic kit, plus Grievous Wounds to cut the Indestructible heal that decides long trades.

edits.before: His R Realm of Death rips you into a 1v1 and steals your tank stats — never get isolated low; W's unstoppable charge is your only way to survive the drag.
edits.after: His R Realm of Death rips you into a 1v1 and steals your stats — a 140s cooldown at rank 1; never get isolated low, and W-charge to cut the damage inside.

edits.before: Level 6 is the danger window: his R drags you into a 1v1 and steals your armor and HP, and a low K'Sante just dies in the realm. Never get caught isolated — and if he ults you, W-charge to become unstoppable and damage-resistant so you ride out the steal. Around your first item you start to flip it: Iceborn plus your bulk lets you eat his Q slam, W him into terrain, and Q3 knock-up before his W heals back up.
edits.after: Level 6 is the danger window: his R drags you into a 1v1 and steals your stats, and a low K'Sante just dies in the realm. Never get caught isolated — and if he ults you, hold W: the charge-up reduces damage taken, so spend it on his Obliterate slam. Around your first item you flip it: Iceborn plus your bulk lets you eat that Q, Q3 knock-up him, and burst him before the 8s Indestructible heal returns.

edits.before: Chain Q slows on Mordekaiser, Q3-knockup when his answer is down, W through the return damage, and decide: peel out or All Out.
edits.after: His whole kit is magic damage — Kaenic Rookern blanks the realm, and Grievous Wounds cuts the Indestructible heal that wins his long trades.

notes: Kit flag on Mordekaiser's Q claims grounding; Riot's description for Obliterate says nothing about grounding dashes, so per the trust-the-description rule I did not write any claim about his Q denying K'Sante's W/E/R dashes. Packet defect about the level chart is stale — the shipped chart already gives K'Sante 4/7 and full/content agree.
